top_findings.title: Standings double-count seasons 2012-2019 (overlapping Brasileirão datasets, no dedup)
top_findings.evidence: src/data-loader.ts:156-225 buildNormalizedMatches concatenates Brasileirao_Matches.csv (2012-2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (2003-2019) with no dedup; verified against raw CSVs: Flamengo 2019 = 38 matches/90 pts in EACH file, and getStandings (src/query-engine.ts:210-268) filters competition via substring includes ('brasileirao' matches both 'Brasileirão Série A' and '... (historical)'), so 2019 standings report 76 matches/180 pts per team. Rankings survive (uniform doubling) but points/match counts are 2x for 2012-2019.
top_findings.suggestion: Dedup on (date, home, away) when merging, or drop novo_campeonato rows with Ano >= 2012

top_findings.title: getTeamStats W/L/D and goals doubled for seasons 2012-2019 (same missing-dedup root cause as R9)
top_findings.evidence: src/query-engine.ts:101-154 getTeamStats iterates db.matches which contains both copies of every 2012-2019 Brasileirão fixture; verified: Flamengo 2019 sums to 76 matches, 180 points. All-time aggregates inflated by the 8-season overlap.
top_findings.suggestion: Same fix as R9 — dedup in buildNormalizedMatches

top_findings.title: headToHead counts doubled and match list has duplicate rows for seasons 2012-2019 (same root cause as R9)
top_findings.evidence: src/query-engine.ts:158-206 headToHead filters db.matches; every 2012-2019 Brasileirão fixture appears twice (competition labels 'Brasileirão Série A' and '... (historical)'), so W/L/D and goal tallies are 2x over that span and the returned match list contains duplicates.
top_findings.suggestion: Same fix as R9 — dedup in buildNormalizedMatches
